gaps.description: Eosinophil CCR3 blockade does not establish exclusive receptor use. Garcia-Zepeda1996 CCR2/CCR3 and Stellato1997 CCR2 transfectant candidates await host-specific full-text extraction.

Historical Taub1993 activation and Taub1995 purification assertions remain provisional because complete methods are unrecovered. New independent ScalleyKim2012 human-PBMC CCL3/4 protein measurements close reviewed ligand coverage, but do not replace those migration or preparation propositions.

Most selected methods recovered through Chrome or primary PDF. Historical Taub1993/1995 methods remain unrecovered. Schall1993 PDF rendered in Chrome but article text was not inspected; native-app CUA call with30-second timeout stalled and was interrupted after485 seconds. No assertion was upgraded from a failed or uninspected retrieval.

Donor counts, ancestry, repeated-donor overlap and experimental precision were incompletely accessible. All cohort independence statuses remain unresolved; cell-line repeats are not donor replication.

Primary human receptor-sensitive BAL T-cell migration and macrophage protein localization now extracted. Conditioned-medium300-19 cell-line bioassays show incomplete CXCL10 neutralization46–79%; no exclusive CXCL10 source-to-human-recipient route is claimed. Loetscher1996 primary PBL migration and fresh-preparation contrast now have full methods. No primary-cell receptor blockade or numerical affinity is inferred from its transfectants or failed binding assay.

Primary cultured-human Th2 calcium responses now extracted separately from Hut78 chemotaxis. Exact chronic Th2 culture recipe referenced by calcium Methods remains unavailable, and transfectant receptor-blockade experiments are not relabeled primary human chemotaxis.

Human macrophage CCL22 and mixed-PBMC CCL3/CCL4 extracellular protein now directly measured. CCL3/4 producing subsets and induction relative to unstimulated culture remain unresolved; other assigned ligands lack extracted secretion assays.

Full methods now recovered. Late antibody-insensitive migration could involve another receptor or an unantagonized CCR3 conformation. No equivalence or proof of receptor independence; study30/8 recruitment differs from per-panel experiments.
Schall1993 PMID7684437 and eLife2020 PMC7669268 remain screened alternatives. Schall primary PDF is accessible in Chrome, but no complete method extraction was made; no assay assertion imported.

synthesis: Twenty-six narrow assertions cover all eight assigned chemokines;20 have inspected full Methods/Results, while6 historical Taub migration/preparation assertions retain needs_full_text. Direct CCL3/CCL4 extracellular protein in stimulated mixed human PBMC and CXCL10 cultured-versus-fresh human PBL chemotaxis are now added. Secretion does not establish induction or target signaling; receptor-transfectant hosts, primary cells and technical replicates remain distinct. No complete pathway, calibrated probability or human adjudication is claimed.
